title.narrative: COVID-19: Health Expenditure and Livelihoods Support Program

description.narrative: The Samoa Health Expenditure and Livelihoods Support (HEALS) Program is part of an integrated package of Asian Development Bank (ADB) support to help the country's short-term efforts to mitigate the severe socioeconomic impacts and manage potential health impacts caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.
